title: Chocolate giants fuel deforestation in West Africa's last rainforest
methodology: Investigation combining satellite imagery, trade and customs data, supply-chain mapping, interviews with more than 30 cocoa-sector sources in Liberia, and requests for comment to companies and traders.
potential_conflicts: Global Witness is an investigative NGO and campaign organisation focused on corporate accountability and environmental and human-rights issues.
limitations: The report identifies indirect exposure through traders and mass-balance cocoa, not direct sourcing by Nestlé from Liberia or a specific Liberian batch in a named product. Nestlé said it did not source directly from Liberia and declined to provide further detail on how it rules out Liberian beans entering its mass-balance supply chain.
